title: Cycle Twelve
transcript:
TAPE 12. Hiss. A chair creaking under someone who can't sit still.

PARTH:
"I remember the tank. All of it. I let go of his hand."

PARTH:
"I can't carry it. Please. Make me forget."

A long silence. Someone breathing close to the microphone.

MEERA:
"You came here to tell me something. You still haven't."

PARTH:
"Make me forget."

MEERA:
"All right. Again."

MEERA:
"I'll stop when you remember why you came."

Click. The counter on the deck stops at 12.
